seat-map.name: config
seat-map.description: Runtime configuration object; merged over the individual attributes for seat-map.

seat-map.name: seatmap
seat-map.description: JSON describing the seat layout: rows, seats and their state. Optional per row: serviceClass (cabin section — first/business/premium/economy, or any provider vocabulary). Optional per seat: features[] (extra-legroom, exit-row, bulkhead, recline-limited, or any provider vocabulary). `type` carries the POSITION (window/aisle/middle); the legacy value extra-legroom is still accepted and folded into features. aisleAfterColumns marks where the aisles go, by 1-based column index: an array ([3, 6] for a 3-3-3 widebody) or a single number for a one-aisle cabin. Omitted, the widest row is split in half. A row may override it with its own rows[].aisleAfterColumns when its section has a different layout (business 1-2-1 over economy 3-3-3); an empty array there means that row has no aisle at all, which is not the same as omitting the key.

seat-map.name: currency
seat-map.description: ISO 4217 currency code used to format amounts.

seat-map.name: maxSelectable
seat-map.description: Maximum number of seats selectable at once.

seat-map.name: density
seat-map.description: How much room the map takes: comfortable | compact. compact shrinks the seat, the gaps and the aisle without removing anything; a 44-row cabin does not fit on a phone. Anything else falls back to comfortable.

seat-map.name: showPrices
seat-map.description: Whether the per-seat surcharge label is drawn. Turn it off where the price does not distinguish seats — the total stays in the summary and the price stays in each seat's aria-label.

seat-map.name: showLegend
seat-map.description: Whether the legend is drawn. The legend already derives from the payload (a map with no features explains none), so this is for maps embedded where the visitor has already seen the conventions.
